data: For fiscal 2025 (calendar year ended December 31, 2025), Tesla had total revenue of about $94.8 billion, down roughly 3% from $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024. Gross profit was about $17.1 billion, a gross margin of roughly 18.0%, slightly above the 17.9% of fiscal 2024. Operating income was about $4.4 billion, an operating margin of roughly 4.6%, down from about $7.1 billion and 7.2% in fiscal 2024. The decline came from lower vehicle deliveries and prices, along with higher operating expenses, including spending on AI and R&D. These figures are from memory and summed from the quarterly results, not taken directly from the filing, so they may be off by a small rounding amount. Please check them against Tesla's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
